title: The Powerpuff Girls
description: The Powerpuff Girls is a animated television series about Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup, three kindergarten-aged girls with superpowers, as well as their “father”, the brainy scientist Professor Utonium, who all live in the fictional city of Townsville, USA. The girls are frequently called upon by the town’s childlike and naive mayor to help fight nearby criminals using their powers.Episode Numbers and Name Will not Match.

episodes.title: S2-E19The Powerpuff Girls Best Rainy Day Adventure Ever
S5-E12The Boys Are Back In Town
S6-E17I See a Funny Cartoon in Your Future

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x1
episodes_data.description: Mojo Jojo unleashes a curse that turns everyone into dogs, including the Powerpuff Girls, but the three sniff out a solution and show Mojo Jojo that their bite is worse than his bark.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x2
episodes_data.description: Professor Utonium falls head-over-heels in love for the lovely Ima Goodlady. Unfortunately, she's really the sinister Sedusa, out to keep the Girls grounded for the first time ever while she commits crimes around Townsville, such as making off with the Mayor's jewels.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x3
episodes_data.description: The Powerpuff Girls hate roaches. Roach Coach uses this to his advantage to take over Townsville. Can the Powerpuff Girls overcome their fear of roaches?

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x4
episodes_data.description: After putting 3 criminals to jail those 3 criminals dress up as the Powerpuff Girls. Spreading crime wherever they go these impostors ruin the girls' reputation.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x5
episodes_data.description: The heinous Him toys with Bubbles' mind by speaking to her through Octi, her favorite stuffed animal. Following Octi/Him's instructions, Bubbles provokes a fight between her sisters that prompts the Professor to issue a time-out until the Girls can make amends and make squid-meat out of the giant, Him-controlled Octi.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x6
episodes_data.description: The Amoeba Boys' ill-conceived plan to stand in front of the "Keep off the Grass" sign at Townsville Park all night in the rain leaves them with a terrible virus. When they infect the Townsville population, it's up to the Girls to find the antidote.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x7
episodes_data.description: Buttercup becomes smitten with Ace, the leader of the Ganggreen Gang. However, when the gang exploits her infatuation and lures Blossom and Bubbles into danger, Buttercup quickly comes to her sisters' rescue and shows the boys the real meaning of the word "crush."

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x8
episodes_data.description: A squirrel trespasses on Fuzzy Lumpkins private property. Fuzzy chases him all the way into Townsville and goes crazy hurting all the citizens that stand in his way.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x9
episodes_data.description: When all the lights go out at night the Boogie Man and his monsters come out to boogie all night long.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x10
episodes_data.description: The Mayor tells the girls' a story about a famous magician who died by a trick with a laughing audience. Now the magician has come back to life to take out his revenge.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x11
episodes_data.description: The Ganggreen Gang gets hold of the Mayor's hotline to the Powerpuff Girls and makes prank calls, sending the Girls on a wild goose chase all over town. However, when it's the notorious villains Mojo Jojo, Fuzzy, and Him that the gang disturbs, they learn the price of making prank calls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x12
episodes_data.description: The citizens of Townsville loves The Powerpuff Girls and its annoying Him, so Him turns everyone's love for the Powerpuff Girls into hate.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x13
episodes_data.description: There's a new man in town: Major Man, an impossibly perfect superhero who cuts in on the Girls' turf. Unfortunately, Major Man isn't as perfect as he is supposed to be as the girls soon discover, and come up with an idea to make Major Man reveal the fraud that he is in the midst of a monster attack.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x14
episodes_data.description: Mojo Jojo kidnaps the Professor in a plot to steal the girls' powers when they arrive.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x15
episodes_data.description: Buttercup teases paste-eating classmate Elmer. When a fly with atomic chemicals enters into the paste, Elmer turns into a destructive Paste Monster. Buttercup has to get out of a sticky situation by doing something against her tough nature—apologizing.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x16
episodes_data.description: On a very hot and humid day Blossom discovers that she has ice powers.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x17
episodes_data.description: Bubbles is tired of people dismissing her as more sugar than spice. When she sets out to prove she's hardcore, she takes everyone by surprise, even Mojo Jojo.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x18
episodes_data.description: Mojo kidnaps the Mayor and the Powerpuff Girls rescue him, but when the Mayor tries to get the story out of them each Powerpuff Girl has their own version.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x19
episodes_data.description: Bubbles saves a seemingly innocent little cat from the clutches of an evil villain, but when the Girls discover it's actually the Cat who is evil, they must save the Professor from becoming the "purr-fect" victim.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 1x20
episodes_data.description: The Mayor creates a commotion in Townsville about being re-elected as Mayor again, but he wakes up Fuzzy Lumpkins who get's annoyed. The people like Fuzzy and vote him Mayor.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x1
episodes_data.description: New student Princess Morebucks comes to Pokey Oaks kindergarten and after seeing The Powerpuff Girls in action she decides to become one.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x2
episodes_data.description: After being arrested by a truant officer, the Gang Green Gang goes back to kindergarten and invades Pokey Oaks with tricks up their sleeves.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x3
episodes_data.description: Nerd boy Lenny Baxter has every single Powerpuff merchandise on the entire planet and now he decides to collect The Powerpuff Girls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x4
episodes_data.description: Next door neighbor Harold Smith can't stand the Powerpuff Girls so he creates a super villain identity to beat the Powerpuff Girls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x5
episodes_data.description: The Professor throws the girls' a birthday party, but when every villain finds out about it they try to ruin the party.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x6
episodes_data.description: The citizens of Townsville take advantage of the Powerpuff Girls and the girls' go out on a strike.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x7
episodes_data.description: Alien broccoloids infect the broccoli of Townsville and now it's up to all the kids in Townsville(including the Powerpuff Girls) to defeat them.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x8
episodes_data.description: Buttercup loves to fight monsters but taking a bath gets in the way, so to continue fighting monsters she doesn't take a bath for 3 days.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x9
episodes_data.description: Putting everyone in the world asleep can be a hard job so to make it easier the Sandman puts the world to sleep forever.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x10
episodes_data.description: Mojo Jojo creates the perfect plan to destroying The Powerpuff Girls ever, but because of an open window in his home Mojo's plan's fall into the Amoeba Boys' hands.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x11
episodes_data.description: Big Billy from the Gang Green Gang gets saved from the train tracks by The Powerpuff Girls. Now he becomes their slave for life.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x12
episodes_data.description: Bubbles gets hit on the head by Mojo and gets amnesia.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x13
episodes_data.description: Blossom steals a set of $2000 golf clubs for Father's Day for the Professor.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x14
episodes_data.description: The Powerpuff Girls save the day before and after their bedtime, and by the time they're at school they always sleep in class. Annoyed by this Ms. Keane talks to the Professor and he gives them a curfew.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x15
episodes_data.description: Princess Morebucks hires Mojo Jojo to think up a brilliant plan to gain the Powerpuff's powers and destroy the Powerpuff Girls along with it.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x16
episodes_data.description: The Professor creates a pet for the girls' that can only be fed once!

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x17
episodes_data.description: A new kid at Pokey Oaks named Mike Believe is very unpopular with his classmates, so he creates an imaginary friend for himself who turns out to be an imaginary fiend.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x18
episodes_data.description: Harry Pitt has the cooties and everyone in Pokey Oaks are avoiding him including the Powerpuff Girls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x19
episodes_data.description: A rainy day in Townsville becomes boring for the citizens of Townsville, so the Powerpuff Girls make the best out a terrible rainy day.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x20
episodes_data.description: Harold Smith finally gets paroled out of jail, and when he comes back to his adoring family they end up hating the Powerpuff Girls just as much as he does. Equipped with all sorts of high tech weapons the Smith's take their revenge out on the Utonium family.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x21
episodes_data.description: To pooped out from fighting crime all the time the Powerpuff Girls create a 4th Powerpuff Girl named Bunny.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x22
episodes_data.description: The tough Buttercup's secret is revealed when her sister's learn that Buttercup's source of power is her little green blankie.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x23
episodes_data.description: After a long week of school the girls' get a long weekend to go to the Bahamas. Buttercup dares them to race home and when they do they travel 50 years into the future.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x24
episodes_data.description: The kids at Pokey Oaks really like The Powerpuff Girls, so Mojo gives a few kids a dose of chemical X.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 2x25
episodes_data.description: Ms. Bellum seduces the Mayor to get some time off, but when something seems a miss the Powerpuff Girls investigate the situation.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x1
episodes_data.description: Old super villain's break out of the retirement home, and the Powerpuff Girls get old super heroes out of retirement to beat them.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x2
episodes_data.description: Bubbles and Buttercup do Blossom's hair, but when it gets tangled they give Blossom a bad hair day.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x3
episodes_data.description: The Professor gets a new job, and the Utonium family moves to the Town Of Citysville. The Professor loves it, but the girls' don't and are having a hard time to adjust to the new changes.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x4
episodes_data.description: The Professor has to go out to an award's ceremony. He forgets to call the babysitter so he calls the Mayor who calls up Mojo Jojo to babysit.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x5
episodes_data.description: The Professor gets a new job, and the Utonium family moves to the Town Of Citysville. The Professor loves it, but the girls' don't and are having a hard time to adjust to the new changes.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x6
episodes_data.description: Bubbles has problems seeing, so she's forced to wear glasses.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x7
episodes_data.description: Princess buys Townsville and makes crime legal.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x8
episodes_data.description: Ms. Keane assigns pet duty since its Friday. The Powerpuff Girls volunteer, but she chooses Mitch to take care of Twiggy, the class hamster.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x9
episodes_data.description: A lazy cop named Mike Bricoski lets his other fellow cops do the dirty work for him, but when he gets fired he takes his revenge out on the Powerpuff Girls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x10
episodes_data.description: Blossom and Buttercup have an argument thinking that brains or brawn is the best way to destroy a monster.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x11
episodes_data.description: Mojo Jojo turns the world into dogs again. The Powerpuff Girls come to the rescue wondering why Mojo does the same plan again. He tells them that he's found a fatal flaw in his old plan as he watches a video of his old plan.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x12
episodes_data.description: A dumb crook hides a jewel in a cereal box. He searches all 3000 of them and when he's down to his last one the Professor buys it for the girls'.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x13
episodes_data.description: After some inspiration from their favorite comics Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup try to become better heroes.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x14
episodes_data.description: When the Mayor rewards the Powerpuff Girls with candy for saving the day the girls' ask Mojo to commit more crimes, so they can get more candy.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x15
episodes_data.description: An unbeatable slime monster comes to Townsville.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x16
episodes_data.description: The Mayor gets sick and tired of the Powerpuff Girls saving the day so he decides to save the day by himself.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x17
episodes_data.description: The Professor sleepwalks and steals toys at the same time. When the girls' find this out they have fun taking advantage of the situation.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x18
episodes_data.description: A new villain steals valuable information from smart people in Townsville, so the Powerpuff Girls use the Mayor as his new target.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x19
episodes_data.description: A female villain named Femme Fatale teaches the girls' to be sexist, so she can get away with crimes.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x20
episodes_data.description: The Professor tries to spend time with his daughters, but they fight crime to much. To solve the problem the Professor creates a power suit, so he could fight crime and spend time with the girls'.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x21
episodes_data.description: After receiving a dollar from the Professor, Buttercup gets hooked and steals other people's teeth for the tooth fairy.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x22
episodes_data.description: Mojo Jojo, Princess Morebucks, Fuzzy Lumpkins, and Him all team up as The Beat Alls to defeat the Powerpuff Girls. All is going well until Mojo Jojo falls in love with Moko Jono who breaks up the Beat Alls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x23
episodes_data.description: Bubbles loves animals and the Professor is sick of her bringing them home, but when she brings home a baby whale the girls' try to hide him before the Professor comes home.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 3x24
episodes_data.description: The Gang Green Gang raids a mini mart eating all types of foods. When the Powerpuff Girls arrive they use their heat vision which causes a chain reaction which gives the Gang Green Gang super powers.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x1
episodes_data.description: Him has given the girls a set of nine riddles to solve in a time limit. The various tasks test both the girls' physical and mental faculties. However, if they fail to complete them all on time, Him promises them that "the Professor will pay".

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x2
episodes_data.description: A sleazy director comes to Townsville to make a movie about the Powerpuff Girls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x3
episodes_data.description: Buttercup smashes Bubbles's chalk when her drawings cover the playground's blacktop.  An angry Bubbles is given magic chalk by Him (disguised as a butterfly) and encouraged to express her anger in her drawings.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x4
episodes_data.description: It's career day at Pokey Oaks and the Professor comes with a time machine and explains how he got into science and created the Powerpuff Girls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x5
episodes_data.description: The girls try to join the superhero organization, the Justice Friends, but they must prove themselves to do so by tests of strength, speed, and smarts. But the only flaw about the organization is it doesn't allow "little girls" into the group and it's centered around men. However, when an enemy attacks the organization, the girls must come to their rescue.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x6
episodes_data.description: Microscopic rain creatures eat away at Townsville.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x7
episodes_data.description: Alien invaders invade Townsville, and the Powerpuff Girls go to Mojo for help.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x8
episodes_data.description: Alien invaders invade Townsville, and the Powerpuff Girls go to Mojo for help.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x9
episodes_data.description: The Professor's old buddy and roommate from college Dick Hardly comes for a visit. When he sees the Powerpuff Girls he comes up with a scheme to make more of them and sell them as a security system.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 4x10
episodes_data.description: A new neighbor named Robin tries to make friends with the Powerpuff Girls, but its hard when they have to save the day all the time. Robin gets sad and makes a new friend: Princess Morebucks.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x1
episodes_data.description: It's Valentine's day and The Powerpuff Girls try to hook up Ms.Keane and the Professor together.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x2
episodes_data.description: After losing a battle with Mojo's robots (which Buttercup defeats) Blossom suddenly becomes a jinx and starts messing up everything.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x3
episodes_data.description: The Powerpuff Girls have to overcome their greatest fears after Him has brought them to life.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x4
episodes_data.description: When the Mayor finds the deed to Monster Isle the monsters move to Townsville causing havoc between monsters and humans.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x5
episodes_data.description: After witnessing a crime, Talking Dog stays at the Powerpuff Girls house for a while as part of a witness protection program.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x6
episodes_data.description: When the Mayor gets a craving for toast he discovers his toaster is broken so he gives it to the Professor to fix, but he accidentally discovers the Professor's secret stash of chemical X which the Mayor uses as a hair growth formula.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x7
episodes_data.description: After stealing a tangerine (orange) and watching it split up into different pieces the Amoeba Boys learn how to multiply and make duplicates of themselves.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x8
episodes_data.description: The girls realize that the Professor is tired after preparing for his dissertation tomorrow, so when a burglar new to Townsville tries to rob them the girls try to stop him without waking up the Professor.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x9
episodes_data.description: The Professor tries to figure out just what kind of species Fuzzy Lumpkins is, but when he accidentally gets covered in mud and flowers it makes him look like a Lumpkin which Fuzzy falls in love with and tries to marry.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x10
episodes_data.description: When the Powerpuff Girls try to stop Mojo from doing a crime an animal activist group comes to his rescue protesting that the Powerpuff Girls can't harm him because he's an endangered animal.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x11
episodes_data.description: When Ms. Keane gets sick she hires a substitute teacher named Mr.Green to run the class in her absence. Unfortunately because of his monstrous appearance the girls assume he's a bad guy and try to save their classmates from him.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x12
episodes_data.description: Him is sick and tired of all the villains (including himself) failing in their never-ending plot to destroy the Powerpuff Girls, so he brings the Rowdyruff Boys back to life and stronger than ever.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x13
episodes_data.description: The girls wake up to discover their bed is wet. Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup all deny to the incident, but they still wonder who did it. This destroys their confidence.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x14
episodes_data.description: Princess interrupts a battle between the Powerpuff Girls and the Rowdyruff Boys. She tries to join the Rowdyruff Boys but they reject her, so out of pity the girls let Princess become a Powerpuff Girl.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x15
episodes_data.description: The owner of the Townsville Museum accidentally thaws out a prehistoric caveman-criminal that was frozen in a block of ice.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x16
episodes_data.description: While cleaning out their closet the Powerpuff Girls reminisce on all the adventures they've had over the years.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x17
episodes_data.description: After the Professor lies to the girls to avoid spending time with them a little white lie monster develops.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x18
episodes_data.description: When Ms. Keane gets sick she hires a substitute teacher named Mr.Green to run the class in her absence. Unfortunately because of his monstrous appearance the girls assume he's a bad guy and try to save their classmates from him.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x19
episodes_data.description: Him is sick and tired of all the villains (including himself) failing in their never-ending plot to destroy the Powerpuff Girls, so he brings the Rowdyruff Boys back to life and stronger than ever.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x20
episodes_data.description: When and organization called Parents Against Powerpuffs tell the Girls that their super-heroics are becoming too imitable for children, the Girls must hold back on fighting crime.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x21
episodes_data.description: When Bubbles overhears the Professor saying some bad words, the Girls add a whole new slew of adjectives to their vocabulary.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x22
episodes_data.description: When the Girls and the Gangreen Gang discover a destructo ray for sale at Mojo's Yard Sale, each team sets out to see who can earn the most money and buy it first.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x23
episodes_data.description: The Professor tries to teach the girls all about the history of silent movies and how their much better than the movies of today by taking them to one.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x24
episodes_data.description: A new group of criminals, which is a group of cute little animals robs Townsville blind. The girls try to stop them, but because of their innocent looks the animal criminals have the advantage.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x25
episodes_data.description: Back when Mojo Jojo tried to take over the world with primates, there was one monkey who didn't get his due - Mopey Popo. Now Mopey is back to try and be evil just as Mojo intended.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x26
episodes_data.description: When the Professor tries out his car, the Girls realize that this K.A.R.R. is taking the Professor away from them, both figuratively and literally.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x27
episodes_data.description: After beating up Fuzzy Lumpkins and other villains to a bloody pulp Blossom and Bubbles start to think that there sister goes a little bit too far when it comes to fighting crime.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x28
episodes_data.description: The Professor tells the girls all about his younger brother Eugene and how he was such a wild man back in the day.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x29
episodes_data.description: The Professor is anxious to win the 2nd Townsville Annual Cook-off competition this year.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x30
episodes_data.description: Dynamo returns and this time is against Townsville and destroying the town along with terrorizing it's citizens.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls 5x31
episodes_data.description: Mojo is sentenced to do community service for Townsville and begins teaching English at the Learning Annex.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: When the Girls hear the Professor trying to make something out of sugar, spice, and everything nice, they are sure he's trying to create new little girls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The Mayor keeps having the same dream over and over again, but he never sees the end. Now it's up Girls to go into the Mayor's head and solve this mystery.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: When Mojo discovers that the Rowdyruff Boys have returned, he competes with Him to determine who's the more evil father.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: One day during a picnic Bubbles get stung in her mouth by a bee. After a visit by the doctor she is forbidden to speak for a week. Suddenly when all the squirrels in Townsville get mad, Blossom and Buttercup are unable to do anything without Bubbles special ability. Now it's up to Bubbles and Bullet to stop this crime.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The Ganggreen Gang is committing brilliant crimes for Sedusa so she can get her revenge on the girls for making her bald.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The girls rescue a baby from a monster and are forced to care for it when they can't find its mother.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: "Custody Battle" Mojo discovers that the Rowdyruff Boys are back and is determined to show them that he is a more evil dad than Him.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The girls get bad sunburns.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Lou Gubrious sets a crying ray on Townsville.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Professor Utomium sends the Steamypuff Girls to save the western town of Townsville from Mojo the Kid.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The Powerpuff Girls must literally work as one to try and stop Mojo Jojo from destroying Townsville.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Captain Crack McGraigen and his crew are tossed forward in time.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The Powerpuff Girls and the Professor set on an old-fashioned vacation to the Townsville Swamp. Trouble is, Fuzzy and his nephews are there too.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Twenty stories tall, The Powerpuff Girls spell disaster for Townsville when they delicately try to stop Mojo Jojo from taking over.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Buttercup feels left out when she realizes that she doesn't have any special powers like her sisters.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: When a TV show convinces kids to send in money to enter a special contest, Bubbles and the rest of the kids in the neighbor hood raise money to enter it.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: A medium named Madame Argentina, and her side-kick, Fred the duck (he really is a duck) attempt to steal money from Townsville's citizens by offering to contact a dead relative for them.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls Season 6 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Professor Utonium is hosting a party for all the rich and famous people in Townsville, so Bubbles makes sure that she is the most beautiful of the girls by continually grooming herself. While doing this, she notices one of Octi's legs poking out from under the girls' bed, so she goes to pick him up to find that all that's there is one of Octi's legs! After waking up from the shock, she vows to exact revenge on the person who 'killed' Octi.
